summary: Implemented the Flask REST API backed by the database-owned schema, with validated task CRUD/status updates, JSON errors, and static UI serving.

messages.content: Backend API is implemented in app.py and is ready for frontend integration. Python syntax and schema loading checks passed; runtime smoke tests could not run because Flask is unavailable locally and package installation cannot reach PyPI.

API is ready: GET/POST /api/tasks; GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/tasks/:id. POST accepts title and optional description; PATCH accepts title, description, and/or status (todo|in_progress|done). Success responses return task JSON; validation errors return {error} with 400, missing tasks return 404, and DELETE returns 204.
Please verify task create/list/read/update/status-move/delete flows plus 400 JSON validation and 404 behavior once Flask dependencies are installed.
Backend validates accepted fields and uses parameterized SQLite values; please review error handling and deployment configuration during the final pass.

blockers: Runtime API smoke tests were not executed: Flask is not installed in the environment, and network access prevented installing requirements from PyPI. Static Python compilation and SQLite schema loading did pass.
